versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to API or features; documentation cleanup only.

- Updated documentation and help links to new URLs (docs now at app.pinax.network/docs, FAQ at app.pinax.network/help).
- Added `GET /openapi` to the list of unauthenticated endpoints.
- Removed redundant unauthenticated endpoint aliases from the list.
- No functional or API changes; documentation and endpoint discovery improved.

## 3.19.0

### Initial Release

- Published the Token API skill for OpenClaw.
- Added unified guidance for real-time token, wallet, DEX, NFT, Polymarket, and Hyperliquid data across EVM, SVM, and TVM networks.
- Documented balances, transfers, holders, metadata, DEX and pool data, NFTs, Polymarket, and Hyperliquid endpoint families.
- Covered authenticated and free unauthenticated endpoints.
- Included error handling, pagination, batched filters, time range parameters, network discovery, monitoring endpoints, worked examples, OpenAPI, docs, and FAQ references.
